Connect.Name: Connect to the Stream Deck from this browser
Connect.Hint: Auto connects only when you're the GM, so players aren't asked for local network access.

PairingCode.Name: Pairing code
PairingCode.Hint: The code shown in any Foundry VTT key's settings in the Stream Deck app, under Foundry connection.

Port.Name: Plugin port
Port.Hint: Must match the port in the Stream Deck plugin (3010 unless you changed it).

Host.Name: Plugin address
Host.Hint: Keep 127.0.0.1 when the Stream Deck is plugged into this computer.

Notify.Name: Connection notifications
Notify.Hint: Say when the Stream Deck connects.

Status.NoCode: Stream Deck Bridge: enter the pairing code from the Stream Deck plugin in this module's settings.
Status.BadCode: Stream Deck Bridge: the Stream Deck plugin rejected the pairing code. Copy it again from a key's settings.
Status.BadProof: Stream Deck Bridge: the program on the plugin port doesn't know the pairing code, so it was ignored.
Status.Replaced: Another Foundry window is now controlling the Stream Deck.

Errors.GMOnly: Only the GM can do that.
Errors.NoActor: The selected token has no actor.
Errors.NoCombatNoSelection: There's no combat: select the tokens to fight first.
Errors.TableMissing: That roll table no longer exists.
